description: `multiverse tasks` treats a failed `agent list` as `live=None`, not a confirmed-empty fleet: an unfinished dispatch (started pane, no status file, no result event) stays RUNNING rather than being promoted to AWAITING. Auto-reconcile also refuses to guess while Herdr is down, so the routing log is unchanged. Scout gap #1.
